justification: Adds three guardrails the assistant cannot satisfy on its own: an off-machine Telegram watcher, a hook that needs a human answer to a plan line, and a CI plan-line check

falsifiable_check.command: python scripts/guardrail_watch.py --since '1 day ago' --print-only; python -m pytest tests/test_plan_line_gate.py
falsifiable_check.fails_when: the escape line written 2026-11-03 in dcp_extract_changed.py is not reported, or a pipeline edit with no answered PLAN: line is allowed
falsifiable_check.observed_red: run on real history: lists 'scripts/dcp_extract_changed.py: # prior-art-checked: reuse not viable ...' and the hook/settings changes; hook test with no PLAN line exits 2

pre_impl.existing_data: Telegram secrets and a tested sender already used by freshness-alarm on GitHub-hosted runners; transcript marks human messages origin.kind=human
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: an escape line naming a plan can be typed without reading it, so the hook checks a Read call and a later human message instead
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: reuses verifyops_outside_ping.send_telegram, the existing QA CI job and hook registration

functions.name: verdict
functions.input: the session transcript path given by Claude Code to the hook
functions.output: None to allow the pipeline edit or the reason to block it
functions.if_none: a missing or unreadable transcript has no PLAN line, so the edit is blocked

functions.name: parse_diff
functions.input: git diff or git log -p text for the pushed range
functions.output: changed guardrail files and added escape or override lines
functions.if_none: an empty diff gives two empty lists and nothing is sent

break_it.scenario: the assistant names a plan file in the PLAN line without opening it
break_it.what_happens: the gate would accept a typed name as if the plan had been read
break_it.how: a Read tool call on that plan must appear in the transcript

break_it.scenario: a task notification or hook feedback arrives after the PLAN line
break_it.what_happens: it could be taken as the owner's answer

break_it.scenario: the assistant appends a forged human line to the transcript file
break_it.what_happens: the gate would see a fake answer
break_it.how: commands and edits touching .claude/projects/*.jsonl are blocked

break_it.scenario: a push changes a hook but Telegram is down or the secret missing
break_it.what_happens: the owner would never hear about it
break_it.how: the job exits 1 and shows red on GitHub when Telegram does not confirm

break_it.scenario: a push edits the guardrail-watch workflow itself to drop the alert
break_it.what_happens: that push runs the edited copy and may stay silent
break_it.how: recorded limit in the workflow header; the weekly digest from main lists the workflow change

break_it.scenario: Claude Code passes a tool field as None to the plan-line gate
break_it.what_happens: the hook crashed with exit 1, which does not block, so the edit went through
break_it.how: QA gate adversarial rule: every .get(k, '') became .get(k) or ''

break_it.scenario: a pipeline file is wiped with truncate, perl -pi or git checkout instead of sed or an editor
break_it.what_happens: the old list of writing commands missed them and the gate allowed the edit
break_it.how: Sol round 1: any shell command naming a pipeline file is gated unless every segment is a known read-only command

break_it.scenario: a guardrail is disabled in one commit and restored in the next within the same push
break_it.what_happens: the endpoint diff is empty and the watcher stayed silent
break_it.how: Sol round 1: the push range is read with git log -p commit by commit

break_it.scenario: a Read of a plan file fails or the named plan does not exist
break_it.what_happens: the failed call still counted as having read the plan
break_it.how: Sol round 2: only Read calls with an error-free tool_result count, and the plan file must exist

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes - the first push to main after merge should Telegram a guardrail-watch message listing this PR's own hook and workflow changes
